title: git-vouch-patatt: write the openssh keyring from the registry
description: Separate executable, Python 3.9+ stdlib only, imports git-vouch's check result. Writes the keyring tree to a directory (atomic replace, stale entries removed, paths built like patatt's make_pkey_path with urlencoding), per the decision bead. Optional --commit-ref REF writes it as a commit on a git ref with plain git plumbing. Never prompts; untrusted registry values never reach a shell.
acceptance_criteria: Tests: tree layout matches patatt's make_pkey_path for sample identities; revoked and unendorsed entries absent; rerun is idempotent; --commit-ref produces a ref readable via git show.
notes: Closed as superseded by vouch-mzkw.7: Mark (2026-10-22) chose a patatt fork reading the registry instead of a generated keyring branch.
